phishing_account_takeover.message: URGENT: Your GTBank account has been temporarily suspended due to suspicious login attempts. Click here to verify immediately: [link] Failure to verify within 24hrs will result in permanent account closure.
phishing_account_takeover.explanation: Fake bank alert using urgency + threat of account closure. Real banks never send verification links via WhatsApp.

phishing_account_takeover.message: Your WhatsApp verification code is: 123-456. Someone accidentally entered your number. Please forward this code to help them out.
phishing_account_takeover.explanation: Classic verification code scam. Forwarding the code gives attacker full control of your WhatsApp account.

phishing_account_takeover.message: MTN Security Alert: Your line will be deactivated today due to incomplete NIN linkage. Update now: [shortened link]
phishing_account_takeover.explanation: Impersonates telco KYC process. Uses government policy (NIN) as pretext to harvest personal data.

phishing_account_takeover.message: Dear Customer, your Access Bank ATM card has been blocked. To unblock, call this number immediately and provide your card details for verification.
phishing_account_takeover.explanation: Vishing variant - asks for card details over phone. Real banks never request full card details via call/SMS.

investment_crypto.message: Invest N50,000 today and get N65,000 in 30 days guaranteed! CBEX is a licensed crypto trading platform used by top bankers. Over 10,000 Nigerians have already cashed out. Don't miss this golden opportunity!
investment_crypto.explanation: Classic Ponzi language: guaranteed returns, social proof (10,000 cashed out), urgency, fake licensing claims. CBEX was a 2025 Ponzi scheme.

investment_crypto.message: I made N2.3 million in 2 weeks with this forex robot. My mentor showed me the secret. If you want the same results, deposit N20,000 to get started. Limited slots remaining!
investment_crypto.explanation: Fake testimonial + scarcity tactic. Forex robot and mentor are common Ponzi framing in Nigeria.

investment_crypto.message: Double your money in 7 days! Loom is the new way Nigerians are beating the economy. Join my WhatsApp group, provide help of N10,000 and receive N20,000. No risk, 100% tested!
investment_crypto.explanation: Provide help/receive help is MMM-era language recycled into new schemes. Beating the economy preys on economic hardship.

investment_crypto.message: Sidra Investment: The halal crypto that pays 40% monthly. Sharia-compliant and backed by UAE sheikhs. Send USDT to this wallet and watch your money grow while you sleep.
investment_crypto.explanation: Exploits religious trust (halal/Sharia) and targets Muslim communities. Fake backed by sheikhs authority claim.

fake_job_offers.message: CONGRATULATIONS! You have been selected for a remote data entry position at Shell Nigeria. Salary: N350,000/month. To secure your slot, pay a N5,000 application processing fee to this account.
fake_job_offers.explanation: Real companies never charge application fees. Shell Nigeria is impersonated frequently.

fake_job_offers.message: UNICEF Nigeria is recruiting 500 graduates nationwide. No experience needed. Submit your CV and pay N2,500 for the aptitude test form. Deadline: tomorrow!
fake_job_offers.explanation: Exploits reputable NGO name + mass recruitment appeal + artificial deadline.

fake_job_offers.message: Work from home and earn $500 weekly! We need 20 Nigerians urgently for Amazon review jobs. Send N10,000 for your starter kit and training manual.
fake_job_offers.explanation: Starter kit fee is the scam. Amazon does not charge for review programs.

fake_job_offers.message: Dangote Refinery mass recruitment is ongoing! 10,000 positions available. Apply now at [fake domain]. Pay N3,000 for fast-track application processing.
fake_job_offers.explanation: Exploits major employer name + mass hiring narrative. Fake domain mimics real company.

fake_giveaways_lottery.message: Are you using MTN? Check if you're eligible to get MTN N10,000 AIRTIME AND 5GB DATA, celebrating 250 million subscribers in Africa. Click https://slnkz.com/Get-bonus
fake_giveaways_lottery.explanation: Real MTN phishing campaign documented by FactCheckHub. Link redirects to data-harvesting site with fake Facebook comments.

fake_giveaways_lottery.message: I received N450,000 from MTN Mobile Money giveaway! You should try it too, it's really easy. Click here to claim your Ramadan gift: [link]
fake_giveaways_lottery.explanation: Documented by Africa Check. Requires sharing to 5-20 friends before receiving gift - reach-farming scam.

fake_giveaways_lottery.message: DANGOTE FOUNDATION 2025 EMPOWERMENT: You have been randomly selected to receive N100,000 cash grant. To claim, send your BVN and account details to this WhatsApp number.
fake_giveaways_lottery.explanation: Impersonates Dangote Foundation. Randomly selected + BVN request = identity theft setup.

fake_giveaways_lottery.message: CONGRATULATIONS! Your email won N5,000,000 in the Coca-Cola Nigeria 50th Anniversary draw. Contact our agent to pay N15,000 for clearance/affidavit processing.
fake_giveaways_lottery.explanation: Classic advance-fee fraud. Real lotteries never require payment to claim prizes.

health_misinformation.message: Drink warm water with lemon and baking soda every morning to cure cancer in 30 days. Big Pharma doesn't want you to know this. Share to save a life!
health_misinformation.explanation: Miracle cure + conspiracy framing (Big Pharma) + emotional manipulation (save a life). No clinical evidence.

health_misinformation.message: Garri causes blindness and cancer because of the cyanide in cassava. Stop eating garri immediately! This is why our grandfathers lived longer - they didn't eat processed garri.
health_misinformation.explanation: Exploits cultural food fears. Cyanide in cassava is neutralized by proper processing; garri is safe when prepared correctly.

health_misinformation.message: Soaked fenugreek seeds improve egg quality and boost libido in women. Fertility doctors are hiding this natural remedy from Nigerian women.
health_misinformation.explanation: Documented false claim by Dubawa. No clinical evidence. Uses doctors hiding it conspiracy framing.

health_misinformation.message: COVID-19 vaccine causes infertility in Nigerian women. The government is using it to reduce population. Do not take the vaccine!
health_misinformation.explanation: Vaccine hesitancy narrative targeting women. Exploits historical medical mistrust + fertility fears.

political_election_misinformation.message: BREAKING: INEC has cancelled the election results in 5 LGAs of Kano. PDP candidate has been declared winner by the tribunal. Share before they delete this!
political_election_misinformation.explanation: Fake breaking news + urgency + share before deletion manipulation. Exploits post-election anxiety.

political_election_misinformation.message: Video: Peter Obi caught on camera agreeing to sell Anambra state assets to foreign investors if elected. This man cannot be trusted!
political_election_misinformation.explanation: AI-generated/manipulated video claim. Deepfake-style misinformation targeting candidates.

political_election_misinformation.message: The new tax reform means anyone earning N800,000 per month will pay 20% tax. Tinubu is punishing the middle class!
political_election_misinformation.explanation: Misrepresents progressive tax structure. N800,000 is annual threshold, not monthly. Documented by FactCheckHub.

political_election_misinformation.message: Trump has revoked 80,000 Nigerian visas exclusively. Buhari is dead in London. Share to expose the government's lies!
political_election_misinformation.explanation: Compound falsehoods mixing international and domestic claims. Documented by FactCheckHub as recycled/fabricated.

romance_scams.message: Hello dear, I'm Captain James, stationed in Afghanistan with the U.S. Army. I came across your profile and felt an instant connection. I hope we can build something special. I have a daughter named Lisa in boarding school...
romance_scams.explanation: Classic military man persona. Creates emotional backstory (daughter, danger) to build trust before money requests.

romance_scams.message: My love, I bought you a surprise gift - a gold necklace and iPhone 16 - but the courier says I need to pay N150,000 customs clearance fee. Can you help me? I'll pay you back when we meet.
romance_scams.explanation: Gift stuck in customs is a standard romance scam playbook. Victim pays fake fees, gift never arrives.

romance_scams.message: Baby, I want to retire soon and spend my life with you. But my bank account is frozen because I'm on a military base. I need N200,000 to process my leave so I can fly to Nigeria to meet you.
romance_scams.explanation: Combines retirement fantasy + financial emergency. Frozen account and leave processing fee are fictional military concepts.

romance_scams.message: You are the most beautiful person I know, inside and out. I can't bear to be without you. I need someone to love me for who I am, not what I have. Can you help me with N50,000 for my daughter's school fees?
romance_scams.explanation: Heavy emotional manipulation (love bombing) pivots to financial request. Targets loneliness and compassion.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Nigeria was designated a Country of Particular Concern by the U.S. over Christian persecution in 2025.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Trump made the designation; but viral claims exaggerated scope and attributed false reactions to Nigerian officials.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: President Tinubu said Nigerians have no fear of whatever Trump is doing in response to the CPC designation.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Video predated Trump's remarks by 2 months; taken out of context.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Trump revoked 80,000 visas exclusively for Nigerians.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Visas were revoked for multiple countries; not Nigeria-specific.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Nigerians earning N800,000 annually will pay 11-20% personal income tax under the 2025 Tax Act.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: N800,000 is the 0% threshold; rates are progressive above that.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Nigerians will pay N500 for every N10,000 spent on petrol under the new tax law.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: 5% fuel levy exists but is not new; no confirmed start date.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Former President Muhammadu Buhari died in London in 2025.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Buhari was alive; funeral video was from Katsina governor's mother.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Peter Obi was invited to Donald Trump's 2025 inauguration.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Not on official guest list; claim originated from pro-Obi platform.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Burkina Faso's Ibrahim Traore rejected a personal invitation to Trump's inauguration.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Traore was never invited; no African heads of state were invited.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: INTERPOL issued an arrest warrant for Burkina Faso President Ibrahim Traore.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: INTERPOL issues Red Notices, not arrest warrants.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Ibrahim Traore made $3 billion from electric car sales in Burkina Faso.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: AI-generated video; company and news agency were fictitious.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: MTN is giving away N10,000 airtime and 5GB data to celebrate 250 million subscribers.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Phishing scam; link redirects to data-harvesting site.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: MTN is offering N450,000 Mobile Money Ramadan gift via online links.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Scam requiring users to share links to 5-20 friends.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Soaked fenugreek seeds improve egg quality and boost libido.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: No scientific evidence supporting the claim.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: Garri causes blindness and cancer due to cyanide in cassava.
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Properly processed garri is safe; cyanide is neutralized during fermentation/drying.

factcheck_api_test_claims.claim: A church was set ablaze by Islamic extremists in northern Nigeria (video).
factcheck_api_test_claims.notes: Video was from Ghana nursing college fire, not Nigeria.
